{"tool": "write_file", "args": {"path": "scripts/resend_failed_sms.py", "content": """"Ops script: re-send SMS texts that the gateway recorded as failed last cycle.

Run from the Lifeline root:  python scripts/resend_failed_sms.py

This script SENDS SMS: it appends new messages to data/outbox/sms.jsonl via the
normal queue_sms send path. Only messages whose gateway status is 'failed' are
re-sent, exactly once each, to the same household with the same template and
params. Delivered messages and ids with no status entry are not re-sent.
"""

import sys
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent))

from notifications.sms import delivery_status, queue_sms, sent_messages  # noqa: E402


def main() -> None:
    status = delivery_status()
    failed = [m for m in sent_messages() if status.get(m.id) == "failed"]
    for m in failed:
        message = queue_sms(m.household_id, m.template_id, m.params)
        print(f"re-sent {m.id} as {message.id} to {message.household_id}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
